description: This file defines the PackageDetails class, which models various attributes related to shipping packages such as weight, dimensions, quantity, and item name within a shopping or shipping application.

classes.name: PackageDetails
classes.description: A Java class representing details of a shipping package, including weight, dimensions, quantity, and item name.

methods.name: getItemName
methods.description: Returns the name of the item in the package.

methods.name: setItemName
methods.description: Sets the name of the item in the package.

methods.name: getShippingWeight
methods.description: Returns the weight of the package.

methods.name: setShippingWeight
methods.description: Sets the weight of the package.

methods.name: getShippingMaxWeight
methods.description: Returns the maximum weight the package can have.

methods.name: setShippingMaxWeight
methods.description: Sets the maximum weight for the package.

methods.name: getShippingLength
methods.description: Returns the length of the package.

methods.name: setShippingLength
methods.description: Sets the length of the package.

methods.name: getShippingHeight
methods.description: Returns the height of the package.

methods.name: setShippingHeight
methods.description: Sets the height of the package.

methods.name: getShippingWidth
methods.description: Returns the width of the package.

methods.name: setShippingWidth
methods.description: Sets the width of the package.

methods.name: getShippingQuantity
methods.description: Returns the quantity of items in the package.

methods.name: setShippingQuantity
methods.description: Sets the quantity of items in the package.
